assets.theme: Spring Rain Umbrellas and Boots Along a Puddle Border
assets.palette: butter yellow, denim blue, coral, pale sky blue
assets.prompt: Create a single horizontal 16:9 decorative illustration for a preschool weather activity sheet and a seasonal children's rainwear web banner. Arrange four cheerful open umbrellas at different heights behind three pairs of little rain boots along the bottom quarter. Give each umbrella a plausible curved canopy with neatly spaced ribs, and keep boot openings, soles and left and right pairs recognizable. A few shallow blue puddles connect the decorative band, with tiny ripples and restrained raindrops confined to the edges. Use classic commercial gouache illustration, opaque matte pigment, precise friendly silhouettes, soft layered shading and delicate brush grain. Balance butter yellow, denim blue and coral against a fresh pale sky blue wash. Preserve the upper central sixty five percent as a nearly uniform light field for dark headlines and teaching instructions; keep all critical motifs within safe cropping margins. No people, shop scene, text, numbers, logos, watermark, divided panels or repeated tiles.
assets.negative_prompt: extra boots, malformed umbrella ribs, excessive rain in copy area, text, logos, watermarks

assets.theme: Colorful Paper Kites and Long Ribbon Tails Diagonal Border
assets.palette: sky blue, tomato red, sunflower yellow, turquoise, ivory
assets.prompt: Design one horizontal 16:9 decorative background for a family outdoor festival banner and a children's recreation program announcement. Place four distinct paper kites near the upper right edge and two smaller kites near the far upper left, forming a sweeping diagonal rhythm without crossing the central text field. Include recognizable diamond and delta shapes, delicate wooden spars, taut paper panels, and short ribbon tails tied to the lower tips. Let the ribbons bend gently with a consistent breeze, keeping every string short and away from the copy area. Render with clean geometric commercial illustration, balanced flat shapes, restrained paper grain and subtle tonal folds at the kite seams. Use sky blue, tomato red, sunflower yellow and turquoise, with a luminous ivory blue center. Keep the left and central sixty percent clear and low contrast, with no landscape horizon or people. Output one continuous background with crisp edges and no captions, logos, watermarks, sample panels or recognizable branded designs.
assets.negative_prompt: crossed strings in copy area, impossible kite frames, flying people, busy clouds, text, logo, watermark

assets.theme: Graduation Mortarboards and Diploma Scroll Corner Frame
assets.palette: midnight navy, antique gold, ivory, muted burgundy
assets.prompt: Create one polished horizontal 16:9 graduation background for a school commencement invitation and an academic congratulations web header. Arrange three traditional mortarboards with clearly formed square tops and naturally falling tassels near the lower left corner, accompanied by two rolled blank ivory diploma scrolls secured with restrained burgundy ribbons. Add two smaller caps and a few simple gold four point sparks in the opposite upper right corner, with generous breathing room between the clusters. Use classic commercial flat illustration with crisp vector like silhouettes, precise edges, restrained matte shading and a sophisticated midnight navy, antique gold and ivory palette. The middle sixty five percent must remain a clean, nearly uniform deep navy field suitable for independently placed white or cream typography. Keep decorative details crop safe, with no school crest, institution insignia or recognizable uniforms. Provide a single uninterrupted raster illustration, no lettering, dates, visible diploma writing, logos, watermarks, photo collage or mockup presentation.
assets.negative_prompt: readable diploma, university emblem, tangled tassels, malformed cap, excessive sparks, logo, watermark

assets.theme: Moon Phases and Fine Celestial Orbit Top Border
assets.palette: deep indigo, warm ivory, muted silver, pale gold
assets.prompt: Make one vertical 9:16 decorative celestial background for a lunar observation journal cover and an astronomy workshop poster. Across the upper quarter, arrange seven distinct moon phase discs along a shallow arc, progressing logically from a waxing crescent through first quarter and waxing gibbous to full moon, then waning gibbous, last quarter and waning crescent. Keep the illuminated portions consistent with a single conventional viewing orientation and give the disks a subtle etched lunar surface rather than arbitrary facial features. Add a handful of tiny stars and two fine decorative orbital arcs confined to the top and upper side margins. Render in vintage celestial line art, with delicate ivory engraved strokes, faint stippled shading and restrained pale gold accents over deep indigo. Maintain the lower central sixty five percent as a calm dark field with minimal grain for light text, including quiet mobile margins. This is one decorative illustration, not a labeled scientific chart. No captions, numbers, logos, watermarks or mystical sigils.
assets.negative_prompt: incorrect moon phase sequence, faces on moons, astrology glyphs, constellation labels, dense starfield in center, watermark

assets.theme: Painted Easter Eggs and Spring Meadow Nest Border
assets.palette: pastel lilac, pale yellow, robin egg blue, sage, ivory
assets.prompt: Paint a single wide 16:9 Easter decorative background for an egg hunt invitation and a spring gift shop promotion. Along the bottom edge place six individually painted eggs, some nestled in a small loosely woven twig nest at the lower left and the rest standing among short spring grass toward the lower right. Vary the egg decorations with tiny dots, restrained stripes, simple petal marks and small checks, using an original coordinated palette of lilac, pale yellow, robin egg blue and sage. Add a few delicate white daisies close to the grass, keeping the decoration low and cohesive instead of building a landscape. Use traditional stationery watercolor with controlled pigment washes, translucent layered color, gently textured edges and subtle warm paper tooth. Preserve the upper central sixty five percent as a bright ivory field suitable for separately typeset event information. Keep objects readable at thumbnail size and comfortably inside the cropping boundary. No people, rabbits, baskets, text, logos, watermark, swatch panels or tiled repeat.
assets.negative_prompt: cracked eggs, distorted nest, duplicate motifs, overly crowded grass, text, logos, watermark

assets.theme: Open Oval Fern and Eucalyptus Botanical Wreath
assets.palette: sage green, olive, muted teal, warm ivory
assets.prompt: Create one portrait 9:16 botanical decorative background for wedding ceremony stationery and a nature inspired wellness workshop poster. Form an open elongated oval wreath using four delicate fern fronds and four slender eucalyptus stems, arranged in alternating clusters along both side margins. Let the tips turn gently inward near the upper and lower quarters, leaving intentional breaks at the top and bottom so the frame feels light and flexible. Draw the fern pinnae with believable attachment and the eucalyptus leaves with distinct rounded forms and fine stem nodes. Render in elegant botanical ink and watercolor, combining restrained fine line detail, transparent sage and olive washes, soft paper tooth and a few muted teal accents. The central fifty eight percent should remain uninterrupted warm ivory for a vertically stacked title and details, with additional quiet mobile interface margins. Keep the plants clearly readable without crossing the central text area. No blossoms, magnolia, pink floral branch, text, logos, watermark, labels or framed sample panels.
assets.negative_prompt: flowers, single branch on paper, tangled fern leaves, foliage blocking center, text, logo, watermark

assets.theme: Lunar New Year Festival Drum and Cymbal Side Border
assets.palette: deep vermilion, warm gold, charcoal, cream
assets.prompt: Design a single horizontal 16:9 Lunar New Year decorative background for a community cultural performance announcement and a shopping center festival banner. Group one traditional barrel shaped festival drum with an ivory drumhead, a small companion drum, two separate brass cymbals and two wooden drumsticks within the rightmost third of the canvas. Use recognizable laced or studded drum construction, rounded cymbal rims and restrained hand painted gold decorative accents without any writing. Arrange the objects as a compact illustrated ornament cluster with a few curved rhythmic brush strokes near the right edge, avoiding a stage or performers. Render with traditional festive ink and gouache, decisive dark contours, matte vermilion pigment, gently brushed gold tones and modest directional shading. Preserve the left and middle sixty percent as a smooth deep red field with sufficient contrast for cream promotional lettering added later. One unified design, no fireworks, lanterns, red packets, zodiac figures, text, logos, watermark or collection board.
assets.negative_prompt: pseudo Chinese characters, incorrect drum construction, duplicate drumsticks, performers, stage, logo, watermark

assets.theme: Christmas Wooden Toy Train with Wrapped Parcel Border
assets.palette: cranberry red, forest green, ivory, warm maple, powder blue
assets.prompt: Illustrate one horizontal 16:9 Christmas decorative background for a toy shop holiday web banner and a children's festive party invitation. Along the bottom quarter place a charming wooden toy locomotive pulling three small connected carriages, each carrying a different arrangement of neatly wrapped parcels with simple ribbon bows. Show clearly formed round wheels, sturdy axles, short couplings and plausible painted wooden shapes on a very shallow snowy track. Keep the train low and compact, leaving visual breathing room at both outer edges. Use classic storybook tempera illustration with matte painted wood, crisp friendly silhouettes, fine brush texture and restrained soft shadows. Combine cranberry red, forest green, warm maple and ivory, with a faint powder blue winter wash behind the bottom edge. The upper central sixty five percent should remain a calm bright ivory field for independently placed titles or product messaging. Avoid a detailed village, tree forest, people or familiar fictional characters. One coherent background, no text, logos, watermark, numbered train or collection panels.
assets.negative_prompt: disconnected couplings, malformed wheels, floating parcels, text, trademarked toy designs, logo, watermark
